name: Mississippi

agency.name: No state wage-and-hour agency; U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division enforces federal law

rates2026.note: No state minimum wage law; the federal FLSA rate applies to covered employers

minWage.smallEmployer: No state minimum wage law: employers not covered by the FLSA have no minimum wage obligation under state law.

tipped.note: Federal tipped cash wage (FLSA); tips must bring pay to $7.25

minWage.other: Federal minimum wage applies (no state law).

source.quote: No state minimum wage law. Employers subject to the Fair Labor Standards Act must pay the current Federal minimum wage of $7.25 per hour.

overtime.note: No state overtime law; federal FLSA overtime (after 40 hours a week) applies to covered employers.

source.quote: No state minimum wage law. Employers subject to the Fair Labor Standards Act must pay the current Federal minimum wage of $7.25 per hour.

sickLeave.note: No statewide paid sick leave law for private employers.

finalPay.fired: no state law (pay by the next regular payday is customary)
finalPay.quit: no state law (pay by the next regular payday is customary)
finalPay.ptoNote: No state statute on vacation payout; follows employer policy or contract.

rightToWorkSource.quote: SECTION 198A. Right to work; labor unions. ... the right of a person or persons to work shall not be denied or abridged on account of membership or nonmembership in any labor union

notes.text: Mississippi is one of the few states with no state minimum wage law: the federal $7.25 applies to employers covered by the FLSA.

source.quote: No state minimum wage law. Employers subject to the Fair Labor Standards Act must pay the current Federal minimum wage of $7.25 per hour.

notes.text: Right to work is written into the Mississippi Constitution (Section 198A).

source.quote: SECTION 198A. Right to work; labor unions.

uncertain: Mississippi has no state labor department page for wages; minimum-wage/overtime absence sourced only from the U.S. DOL state table.
Absence of state final-pay, vacation-payout, break, sick-leave and family-leave laws not confirmed on an official Mississippi page (sources null). Child-labor break rules for minors not checked.
